paragraphs: Quantcast’s real‑time ad optimisation demands models that can adapt instantly; I built a tool‑calling LLM agent that resolves gene aliases, explains scoring methodology and tracks dataset provenance for a multi‑omics cancer platform, proving my ability to integrate complex data streams into a single, responsive system.

I also engineered scikit‑learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deploying them as FastAPI services in Docker, demonstrating my end‑to‑end delivery from model training to production.
Could we schedule a brief call so I can walk you through how my LLM agent and model deployment pipeline could enhance Quantcast’s real‑time bidding algorithms?
